parameters.query:
WITH c AS (
  INSERT INTO classifications
    (ticket_id, category, priority, confidence, reasoning, is_valid, raw_response, model, prompt_version, input_tokens, output_tokens)
  VALUES ($1, $2, $3, $4, $5, $6, $7::jsonb, $8, 'v3', $9, $10)
  RETURNING id, ticket_id, category, priority, confidence, is_valid
)
UPDATE tickets t
SET status = CASE WHEN c.is_valid THEN 'classified' ELSE 'error' END, updated_at = now()
FROM c WHERE t.id = c.ticket_id
RETURNING c.*;

SELECT coalesce(json_agg(k), '[]'::json) AS articles, count(*) AS hits, clock_timestamp() AS kb_done_at
FROM search_kb($1, $2, 3) k;

WITH d AS (
  INSERT INTO drafts
    (ticket_id, classification_id, draft_body, kb_article_ids, model_unsure,
     routed_to, routing_reason, model, prompt_version, input_tokens, output_tokens)
  VALUES ($1, $2, $3, $4::bigint[], $5, $6, $7, $8, 'v1', $9, $10)
  RETURNING id, ticket_id, routed_to, routing_reason
)
UPDATE tickets t SET status = d.routed_to, updated_at = now()
FROM d WHERE t.id = d.ticket_id
RETURNING d.*;

INSERT INTO pipeline_steps (ticket_id, n8n_execution_id, step, status, started_at, finished_at, meta)
VALUES
  ($1, $2, 'classify',  $3,   $4::timestamptz, $5::timestamptz, $8::jsonb),
  ($1, $2, 'kb_lookup', 'ok', $5::timestamptz, $6::timestamptz, $9::jsonb),
  ($1, $2, 'draft',     'ok', $6::timestamptz, $7::timestamptz, $10::jsonb),
  ($1, $2, 'route',     'ok', $7::timestamptz, clock_timestamp(), NULL)
RETURNING step, duration_ms;
